holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: ICICI Bank approved Q2 FY2027 standalone net profit of ₹14,843 crore, up 20.1% year-on-year, and consolidated profit of ₹16,333 crore.
For the quarter ended September 2026, revenue stood at ₹55,992 crore with net profit of ₹17,389 crore.
The bank's CASA ratio dropped 340 bps to 36.1% as foreign currency non-resident deposits rose.
Fixed deposit rates were raised up to 7.30% for senior citizens, and savings account cash transaction charges will be revised from December 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank is the fund's largest reported position at 3.94%. Together with HDFC Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank, it anchors the fund's 17% allocation to Financials.

watch.text: Implementation of revised savings account cash transaction charges effective December 1, 2026.

holdings.name: Adani Power Ltd

what_changed.text: Adani Power reported consolidated net profit of ₹7,019.32 crore for Q2 FY2027, rising more than double year-on-year on sales of ₹19,439 crore.
The company received a Letter of Award from UPCL for 1,234 MW thermal power supply under a 25-year power supply agreement.

holdings.why_it_matters: Adani Power holds a 3.48% fund weight and was one of the largest 3-month detractors, returning -14.80% and contributing -0.515% to portfolio returns.

watch.text: Operational progress under the 25-year 1,234 MW thermal supply agreement with UPCL.

holdings.name: Adani Enterprises Ltd

what_changed.text: Adani Enterprises posted sales of ₹32,924 crore and a net loss of ₹1,462 crore in the June 2026 quarter.
The company signed an MoU with Jabil to form a 50:50 joint venture for AI and data centre hardware production in India.
CARE upgraded the company's long-term rating to AA Stable across ₹16,505 crore of facilities.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.47% fund weight, Adani Enterprises was the biggest single detractor over the last 3 months, falling 18.15% with a -0.630% contribution to fund performance.

watch.text: Board meeting on October 28, 2026 to approve Q2 FY2027 and half-year financial results.

holdings.name: Divi's Laboratories Ltd

what_changed.text: Operating profit reached ₹1,255 crore on sales of ₹3,080 crore in the June 2026 quarter, with operating margins at 41%.
Shares rose following EU panel backing for a weight loss drug and brokerage identification of peptide CDMO opportunities.

holdings.why_it_matters: Divi's Laboratories was the fund's top 3-month contributor, returning 23.47% and generating an estimated +0.791% contribution at a 3.37% portfolio weight.

watch.text: Board meeting on November 7, 2026 to consider Q2 FY2027 financial results.

holdings.name: KPR Mills Ltd

what_changed.text: Sales reached ₹1,936 crore and net profit rose to ₹259 crore in the quarter ended June 2026.
Management held investor interactions with InCred Asset Management and Asian Market Securities in September 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Represents 3.06% of the portfolio within Consumer Discretionary, the fund's largest sector exposure at 25.2%. The stock was down 3.22% over 3 months.

watch.text: Board meeting scheduled for October 28, 2026 to review Q2 and H1 FY2026-27 unaudited results.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Revenue rose to ₹95,132 crore with net profit of ₹21,537 crore in the September 2026 quarter.
The bank initiated an internal probe into two senior executives regarding an alleged leak of confidential information.
Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha will step down on December 31, 2026, while Lily Vadera was reappointed as independent director.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holds 3.02% of the portfolio. Long-term weakness (-31.32% over 1 year and -6.73% over 3 months) continues to weigh on the fund's Financials allocation.

watch.text: Resolution and findings of the internal investigation into information leaks.
Executive transition following the cessation of the Deputy MD role on December 31, 2026.

holdings.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: The RBI approved Anup Kumar Saha as MD and CEO of the bank for three years starting January 1, 2027.
Provisional Q2 FY2027 net advances reached ₹5,77,094 crore and deposits rose to ₹6,51,491 crore.
Net profit increased to ₹5,480 crore on revenue of ₹18,355 crore in the June 2026 quarter.

holdings.why_it_matters: Kotak Bank is a 2.67% holding and the fund's third-largest 3-month positive contributor (+0.317% contribution on an 11.89% return).

watch.text: Earnings announcement on October 24, 2026 for Q2 FY2027 results.
Formal transition of the MD and CEO role taking effect January 1, 2027.

holdings.name: Aether Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Revenue reached ₹327 crore and net profit rose to ₹63 crore in the quarter ended June 2026.
A CGST show-cause notice demanding ₹4.26 crore was dropped on October 1, 2026 without financial impact.
CRISIL assigned AA-/Stable and A1+ credit ratings to ₹636 crore bank facilities and raised the company's ESG score to 58.

holdings.why_it_matters: Represents 2.61% of the fund in Materials. While it experienced a 1-month correction of -14.82%, it has gained 84.11% over 1 year.

watch.text: Board meeting and earnings call scheduled for October 30, 2026 for Q2 and H1 FY2026-27 results.

holdings.name: Paradeep Phosphates Ltd

what_changed.text: Signed an MoU with the Government of Odisha to invest ₹4,750 crore in new chemical and fertilizer facilities.
Appointed Raj Kumar Agrawal as an Additional Independent Director for five years from October 13, 2026.
Reported sales of ₹6,124 crore and net profit of ₹393 crore in the June 2026 quarter.

holdings.why_it_matters: Accounts for 2.30% of the portfolio in Materials. It has declined 22.90% over 1 year and dropped 13.12% over the last month.

watch.text: Execution milestones on the planned ₹4,750 crore capital outlay in Odisha.
Impact of El Nino patterns on fertilizer consumption during the Rabi season.

holdings.name: Lenskart Solutions Ltd.

what_changed.text: Sales reached ₹2,714 crore with net profit of ₹228 crore and operating margins of 22% in the June 2026 quarter.
Alpha Wave Ventures sold shares worth over ₹1,700 crore via block deals, while domestic institutions and mutual funds increased stakes.
Customs authorities issued an order demanding ₹13.17 crore duty and penalty on imported optical frames.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.19% fund weight, Lenskart contributed +0.288% over 3 months with a 13.15% return, supporting the Consumer Discretionary book.

watch.text: Board meeting and earnings call on November 4, 2026 to review Q2 FY2027 results.

portfolio.statement: SBI MultiCap Fund maintains heavy allocations to Consumer Discretionary (25.2%), Materials (22.7%), and Financials (17.0%), while experiencing negative short-term momentum (-5.54% over 3 months).
interp: Top positive contributors over 3 months were led by Divi's Laboratories (+0.791%) and Kotak Mahindra Bank (+0.317%), counterbalancing weakness in power and conglomerate holdings.
Negative performance was driven by sharp corrections in Adani Enterprises (-0.630% contribution) and Adani Power (-0.515% contribution), alongside persistent declines in HDFC Bank.
portfolio.line: Gains in Healthcare and selective private banks failed to fully offset steep drawdowns across Adani group holdings and HDFC Bank.

drivers.text: Divi's Laboratories generated a 23.47% 3-month return, adding 0.791% in estimated contribution following optimism around peptide CDMO demand.
Kotak Mahindra Bank rose 11.89% over 3 months (+0.317% contribution) as deposit growth and CEO leadership clarity supported sentiment.
Adani Enterprises fell 18.15% over 3 months (-0.630% contribution) following a net loss in the June 2026 quarter.
Adani Power detracted -0.515% over 3 months with a 14.80% decline, despite reporting a consolidated net profit of ₹7,019 crore in Q2 FY2027.
HDFC Bank dropped 6.73% over 3 months amid an internal investigation into confidential information leaks by senior executives.

themes.title: Private Banking Divergence
themes.text: Performance diverged across large private lenders, with Kotak Bank gaining on operational metrics while HDFC Bank dealt with internal information leak probes.

themes.title: Adani Group Headwinds
themes.text: Power and materials exposures under the Adani group faced significant price drawdowns over the past quarter despite positive long-term contracts and ratings upgrades.

themes.title: Specialty Healthcare & CDMO
themes.text: Healthcare allocation benefited from peptide manufacturing demand and European regulatory developments.

macro.why: Long-term state utility supply contracts underpin revenue stability for thermal power producers.

macro.factor: Bank Funding Costs and Deposit Composition
macro.why: Deposit mix shifts and falling CASA ratios create margin pressure across commercial lenders.
Rabi crop planting and El Nino climate cycles directly influence domestic fertilizer uptake.

priced_in.text: Adani Enterprises' balance sheet profile incorporates CARE's upgraded AA Stable rating across ₹16,505 crore facilities.
Kotak Mahindra Bank's governance framework accounts for the RBI-approved CEO transition taking effect on January 1, 2027.
Aether Industries' credit standing incorporates CRISIL's AA-/Stable and A1+ ratings assigned to its ₹636 crore bank facilities.

could_change.title: Conclusion of HDFC Bank Data Leak Review
could_change.text: The outcome of the internal probe into confidential data leaks by senior executives could influence market sentiment and governance scrutiny.

could_change.title: Execution of Adani-Jabil Hardware JV
could_change.text: Operational progress and capital deployment under the 50:50 joint venture could alter Adani Enterprises' high-tech manufacturing footprint.

portfolio.risk_note: The portfolio has a high cyclical concentration, with Materials and Consumer Discretionary together representing 47.9% of total assets, accentuating sensitivity to corporate capex and consumer spending cycles.
